g.text: +create(product: Product, size: PizzaSize, price: Money, units: int | null): ComponentSizeConfiguration
+revised(product: Product, price: Money, units: int | null): ComponentSizeConfiguration
Existing validate(schema) returns a function validating req.body only.
Routes register create schema for POST and update schema for PATCH.
POST requires all fields; PATCH requires at least one known field.
PATCH fields are optional; omitted fields stay omitted.
Both schemas use strict types; no coercion, defaults or rounding.
Core business checks remain in Domain.
validatePath(req) checks route references in the controller.
Identity = (ProductId, PizzaSizeId); no generated configuration ID.
create/revised validate component eligibility and price policy.
EUR; finite amount >= 0; at most 2 decimals; no rounding.
Otherwise units must be null (including rejecting numeric zero).
revised preserves both references and returns a validated candidate.
Product and Size have independent lifecycles, not owned children.
